description: Shared Renovate preset for nf-* pipelines and nf-sub-* subworkflows. Tracks nf-mod-* versions via the modules.versions file at the repo root, with semver-aware propagation rules.

customManagers.description: Track nf-mod-* versions declared in modules.versions. Each line: nf-mod-<name>=v<MAJOR>.<MINOR>.<PATCH>

packageRules.description: PATCH bumps of nf-mod-* submodules: no propagation. Disabled entirely.
MINOR bumps of nf-mod-* submodules: auto-PR, group, and automerge. The post-merge sync workflow updates the submodule pointer; the auto-release workflow bumps this repo's MINOR.
MAJOR bumps of nf-mod-* submodules: no automatic propagation. The module repo's release workflow opens a tracking issue here instead.
